question: What share of the Agave angustifolia chloroplast genome do the two inverted repeats make up together?
rendered:
Document title: Genomic Potential and Climate Resilience of Agave angustifolia Haworth in Raicilla Production

The two inverted repeats make up 26,575 bp each, for a total of 53,150 bp. The chloroplast genome size is 157,274 bp. 

To calculate the share, divide the total size of the inverted repeats by the total genome size: 

(53,150 bp / 157,274 bp) * 100 = 33.85%

So the inverted repeats make up approximately 33.85% of the Agave angustifolia chloroplast genome.
